description: Voice to structured Markdown prompts — run local saymd, then @ .ai/prompt.md

defaultPrompt: Use saymd to record a feature idea into .ai/prompt.md, then implement from that file.
Turn a voice bug report into .ai/prompt.md with saymd, then fix from the structured spec.
Run saymd with the plan template and start coding from .ai/prompt.md.
interface.longDescription:
saymd turns speech or audio files into a structured Markdown prompt (Objective, Context, Instructions, Constraints) that Codex can @. Runs your local Free MIT CLI (npx saymd) with Bring Your Own Key for Gemini, OpenAI, Deepgram, or ElevenLabs. Audio never goes to saymd.app.

Typical loop: record with the CLI → open .ai/prompt.md → implement from the spec.

name: saymd
